subject: TAN function
notes: 15.89.3 r1 'shall be of class numeric' -- TAN's rejecting branch, which nothing in the corpus screened (pb1 covers ACOS/ASIN/ATAN, pb52 covers SQRT): PIC X(3) and PIC ZZ9.99 (numeric-edited, class alphanumeric by 8.5.2.1 Table 2) both draw COBOL1627 at every edition, with the TAN format golden's four class-numeric shapes as the accepting complement.
